passage.label: where going; not except reminder worlds; whoever wills among take right course; not will except Allah wills Lord worlds

arabicExcerpts.text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

mainSubject.label: The direction question posed — where are you going — answered by naming the Quran nothing but a reminder to the worlds for whoever wills to take a right course, with human willing nested under the will of Allah, Lord of the worlds

subordinateSubjects.label: The direction question: so where are you going
At-Takwir names it a reminder addressed to all the worlds
For whoever among you wills to take a right course
Yet you do not will except that Allah wills, Lord of the worlds

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Direction questioned: where are you going after rejecting the reminder

relationships.label: Reminder to the worlds available to whoever wills a right course
Human willing nested under the will of Allah, Lord of the worlds

terminology.gloss: to take a right course (editorial gloss)

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the soul-knowing-what-it-brought verdict (14) before the star-night-dawn oaths open (15); P2 ends with the expelled-devil denial (25) before the direction question begins (26); P3 covers the where-going challenge, the reminder-to-the-worlds function and the divine-will nesting (26-29).
